* REQ: LANG-2071 LANG-2072 LANG-2073 LANG-2074
        OUTPUT = "Hello, world!"
        X = 'SNOBOL' ' ' "4"
        LINE = INPUT                        :F(DONE)
        LINE SPAN('0123456789') . N         :S(NUM)F(LOOP)
NUM     OUTPUT = "number " N                :(LOOP)
DONE    OUTPUT = SIZE(X)
END
